limitations: Readers take an already-parsed document; bytes-to-object parsing belongs to the import pipeline
A path parameter value containing a slash is refused: containment inside the approved prefix cannot be proven across intermediaries
Credentials come from the custody port only; the host's credential layer must write the expected names
An OpenAPI description declares no upstream revocation operation. Local disconnect is available and does not establish upstream revocation.
The forwarder's outbound signature header and algorithm are not published, so the verifier is injected; the test verifier is a stand-in, not a claim about the forwarder's wire format
